newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks end off, profit taking breaks rally.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks end off, profit taking breaks rally.

text.p: Caracas stocks broke their week-long winning streak on Tuesday, closing off in moderate trade as investors took profits, traders said.
"Some investors liquidated their positions, but they're only waiting for the adjustment to play itself out before they come back," said Multinvest broker Jose Gregorio Tineo.
The bolsa's 19-share index slipped 0.7 percent to end at 7,254.52 points as 129 million shares traded worth 5.3 billion bolivars ($11 million).
Telephone company CANTV led losers, dropping 2.41 percent to end at 2630.00 bolivars.
The stock's drop pushed Merinvest's composite index, which includes CANTV, down 1.1 percent to 114.69 points.
Among traded issues, 18 fell, 16 rose and 10 closed flat.
Despite the drop, traders said the trend was still up.
"If the session opens tomorrow with prices falling, we could well see the bolsa recover again towards the end of the week," commented one trader.
